compatibility.notes: Official project: efibalogh/sparkle-ig (publishes .deb assets); this source serves the ready-to-sideload IPA build from the IPA Vault. Instagram 445.x builds require iOS 15.1 or newer. Uses its own bundle identifier (com.burbn.instagram.sparkle) - installs alongside the stock app.
